query: Hey, I'm in San Francisco and I'm looking for a dentist that offers cosmetic services. After finding one, I would like to book an appointment for 2pm on the 1st of May.

function.name: BookAppointment
function.description: Book an appointment at a dentist for a given time and date. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

function.name: FindProvider
function.description: Find a dentist by location and optionally by services offered. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.
